iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now available for pre-order. Apple unveiled the two new phones on Wednesday, highlighting a variable aperture camera system, a smaller Dynamic Island, four new colours, and more.

  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro from Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max from Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro from Walmart
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max from Walmart

You can now pre-order iPhone 18 Pro

As a recap, here are some of the highlights of the iPhone 18 Pro lineup:

  • A new variable aperture main camera for more flexible control of light and depth of field.
  • A new A20 Pro chip with 50% more memory bandwidth and 40% faster GPU performance.
  • A smaller Dynamic Island that can display three Live Activities simultaneously.
  • Significantly improved battery life. The iPhone 18 Pro can last up to 24 hours in real-world use, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max can last up to 30 hours.
  • A new-generation vapor chamber design for better sustained performance.
  • Faster wired charging: 50% in 15 minutes.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max come in four colors:

  • Bordeaux
  • Glacier Blue
  • Silver
  • Black

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at $1,299. Base storage is 256GB, expandable up to 2TB. Purchase options include paying in full, using Apple Card or carrier instalment plans, as well as the new Apple Upgrade programme.

The first wave of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders will arrive next Friday (18 September). The next device up for pre-order will be the iPhone Duo, which opens for pre-order on 16 October and begins shipping on 23 October.

Will you pre-order an iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max? Or are you waiting for the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
